blocks.html: The temperature differential between makeup air delivered to the space and the air in the conditioned space shall not exceed 10ºF (6ºC) except where the makeup air contributes to satisfying the heating or cooling loads of the space and such temperature differential does not exceed 25°F (-38.9°C). The makeup air delivered to a compensating hood with front facing or side facing discharges shall be considered as being delivered to the space for the purposes of this section.
